title: QC RTC junks Sara Duterte's motion to inhibit judge in grave threat case
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The Quezon City Regional Trial Court has denied a motion seeking the recusal of the presiding judge handling the grave threat case against Vice President Sara Duterte.…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Quezon City Regional Trial Court has denied a motion seeking the recusal of the presiding judge handling the grave threat case against Vice President Sara Duterte. “We note the Court’s order denying the motion to inhibit by the accused,” Department of Justice (DOJ) Spokesperson Atty. Polo Martinez said. However, he refused to give other details “in observance of the sub judice rule.” READ: Sara Duterte impeachment trial: Who is lawyer James Bryan Ibrahim Alih? Under the Sub Judice Rule, making public statements, comments, or media coverage regarding ongoing court proceedings is restricted. The vice president’s legal camp […]...
